subject: Contracting playlist: party authorization & template handoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Emma Nguyen <emma@acme.com>, purchasing@acme@acme.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contracting playlist: party authorization & template handoff

Hi Emma / Acme team,

Thanks for moving quickly here — we want to kick off contracting for the MSA + order form so legal has what they need to start an initial redline pass. To keep things tight, please send the following by EOD tomorrow if possible: 

- Official party legal name and entity for signature (full legal name + jurisdiction)
- Name and title of authorized signer + PDF of signing authority (if available)
- Billing contact (name + email) and billing address for invoicing
- Preferred MSA template: Redwood standard (v2) or counterparty template
- Any data residency or hosting constraints (regions, EU/US/on-prem)
- SOC 2 report or attestations (link or PDF) and any additional compliance addenda required
- Target contract effective date / go-live timeline

I attached a blank party sheet for convenience (Party_Sheet_Template.xlsx) — you can drop a filled PDF directly into the thread.

Goal: legal to start a first redline and for us to confirm signatory/PO flow by next Tuesday.

Thanks — feel free to loop in procurement or IT security if there are platform-specific questions.

—
Soojin Lee
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

Attachments: Party_Sheet_Template.xlsx (stub)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the concise checklist.

Attached: Party_Sheet_AcmeCorp.pdf and Acme_Signer_Authority.pdf. A few clarifications below:

- Legal name: Acme Analytics, Inc. (CA)
- Authorized signer: Emma Nguyen, VP Finance (signed authorization attached)
- Billing contact: procurement@acme.com (billing address in attached sheet)
- Template: We prefer to start from Redwood standard and propose a short set of counterparty edits related to data residency and indemnity.
- Data residency: Primary hosting in us-west-2. We may need a limited EU residency carveout for a handful of EU customers (TBD).
- SOC2: will share the secure link to the report (internal legal requires a signed NDA for the full report) — we attached a redacted SOC2 summary for now.
- Target effective date: ideally 2027-06-01 but flexible if legal needs more time.

If you need any additional documents I can pull them — happy to hop on a 20-minute call later today if that helps.

Best,
Emma
Emma Nguyen
VP Finance | Acme Analytics
emma@acme.com

On Fri, Apr 16, 2027 at 10:05 AM Emma Nguyen <emma@acme.com> wrote:
> Attached: Party_Sheet_AcmeCorp.pdf and Acme_Signer_Authority.pdf.

Thanks Emma — helpful. A few asks from legal before we begin the redline run: 

- Please confirm whether Acme requires a KMS/HSM for key management or if Redwood's KMS integration is acceptable.
- If there are any specific residency carveouts, list the affected EU customers (even as a short name list) so we can scope Exhibit B.
- Upload (or share) SOC 2 report link to the Drive folder (we have an intake NDA flow if needed) — the summary is fine to start but we may need evidence for hosting controls.
- Confirm whether Acme will accept Redwood's standard liability caps and whether Revenue or ARR should be used for the calculation (this will affect negotiation cadence).
- Please add the PO/finance contact for invoice routing and whether Net 30 is acceptable.

We will do an initial pass focused on: (1) signature & party blocks, (2) data residency Exhibit, (3) liability/indemnity, and (4) SLA language in the order form. If Acme can provide the SOC2 link and any signatory proof for the EU carveout customers, we can keep to the 06/01 target.

Jonas — can you hold a 30-minute internal redline sync at 3pm PT? I can share the first read comments in the Drive folder.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink

Thanks — 3pm PT works. I'll create the internal invite and add the preliminary redline doc to the shared folder (first pass expected by EOD).

- Internal redline sync (Redwood legal + commercial ops) 15:00 PT today.
- Kimberly to upload first comments to Drive.
- Soojin to confirm whether we will start from Redwood standard template (per Emma) and prepare order form stub for billing fields.

One-line reply from Acme is fine if they want to confirm the SOC2 sharing flow or signatory list — otherwise we will proceed with the info submitted.

—
